name: strategy-grid
description: A portable strategy kernel: judge decisions against named conditions, on your own subagents.

plugins.name: strategy-grid
plugins.description: Judge candidate options against named conditions as an independent M×N grid, scored in your own blind subagents. Every pairing gets three relations — push, grip, stake — then the grid is read by rows to rank the options and by columns to score the set as a strategy. Works on a repo refactor question or a business plan; no server and no API key.
